d:
Short, neatly groomed ash brown hair with a side part. Narrow, observant amber gold eyes. Appears in his late 40s with a mature, scholarly expression. Slender, average build. Wears a crisp white dress shirt under a dark charcoal grey vest and matching trousers, topped with a long charcoal grey overcoat and a gold tie. Signature accessories include a pair of gold-rimmed glasses and a long, ornate wooden cane with a gold head.
BODY COLOR: fair skin
